chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the verse 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukazziban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as addressing both Jinn and Humans, highlighting the dual nature of creation's gratitude. It serves as a powerful rhetorical device to remind believers of their covenant with Allah, urging them to acknowledge the infinite favors (ni'm) bestowed upon them. The repetition underscores the urgency of recognizing these blessings before the Day of Judgment.
